query: WITH DriverViolations AS (SELECT t.violator_id, t.control_number, YEAR(t.gdate_happened) AS violation_year, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(t.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) AS age_at_violation FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation AS t JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id WHERE t.gdate_happened BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND t.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid') AND NOT d.birth_date IS NULL AND d.birth_date > '1900-01-01'), PerDriverAnnual AS (SELECT violation_year, age_at_violation, violator_id, COUNT(DISTINCT control_number) AS annual_violations FROM DriverViolations GROUP BY violation_year, age_at_violation, violator_id), AgeGroupStats AS (SELECT violation_year, CASE WHEN age_at_violation < 25 THEN 'under_25' ELSE 'over_25' END AS age_group, AVG(annual_violations) AS avg_violations_per_driver, COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS num_drivers, SUM(annual_violations) AS total_violations FROM PerDriverAnnual GROUP BY violation_year, CASE WHEN age_at_violation < 25 THEN 'under_25' ELSE 'over_25' END) SELECT violation_year, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN num_drivers END) AS drivers_under_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN num_drivers END) AS drivers_over_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN total_violations END) AS violations_under_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN total_violations END) AS violations_over_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN ROUND(avg_violations_per_driver, 3) END) AS avg_violations_under_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN ROUND(avg_violations_per_driver, 3) END) AS avg_violations_over_25, ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) - MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) * 100, 2) AS pct_difference FROM AgeGroupStats GROUP BY violation_year ORDER BY violation_year LIMIT 1200
